messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCORRECT_CAPACITY_WARNING: primary-eu1 GPU pool saturated; autoscaler failing to allocate new nodes. queue_length metric rising across inference-queue-0 -> 18k pending requests. paging oncall. Please ack and triage.

kai (oncall): acked. I'm jumping in. what's the current customer impact? any 5xx spikes?

ellie (support): getting multiple CS tickets from a couple of large customers (Prod tier) reporting timeouts and degraded responses — some see 504s after ~45s. spike in real-user reports starting ~2967890000.

maria (sre): initial telemetry: primary-eu1 gpu-util > 98%, pool node count at max (configured limit = 120 G4 instances). autoscaler logs show repeated "quota_exceeded" when requesting new instances. also seeing "launch_timeout" 3x in last 5m.

raj (runtime): adding routing info: spillover policy should steer low-priority traffic to eu2 and us-west if eu1 saturated. looks like routing circuit breaker kept primary sticky for some customers — per-tenant pinning. we need to enable emergency cross-region fallback.

sasha (eng): can we flip the emergency_fallback? that's in the console under Routes -> CrossRegion -> emergency-fallback (boolean). If we toggle, requests will be routed to eu2 pool variants (same model family).

kai (oncall): steps I'd like to try: 1) disable tenant pinning for affected customer groups 2) enable emergency_fallback for 10m 3) scale up eu2 reserved burst if needed. Anyone object?

maria (sre): no objections. but note eu2 currently at 70% — we can allocate burst capacity but that also hits quotas in the account. I'll check cloud quota and open quick request if needed.

ops-bot: runbook-entry: INCIDENT-2044 GPU_POOL_EXHAUSTION - recommended actions: disable pinning -> enable fallback -> throttle best-effort routes -> notify customers.

kai (oncall): doing step 1 now: running update to unset tenant pin for group ids [c-101,c-223,c-305].

```bash
# api call to unset tenant pin
curl -X POST "https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing/unpin" -d '{"tenants": ["c-101","c-223","c-305"]}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_ADMIN"
```

kai (oncall): response ok 200. unpinned.

sasha (eng): enabling emergency_fallback -> toggling to true for primary-eu1, ttl 600s.

```json
{"route":"primary-eu1","emergency_fallback":true,"ttl":600}
```

ops-bot: action applied: emergency_fallback=true for route primary-eu1 (actor: sasha).

maria (sre): monitoring metrics: within 30s we see spillover traffic -> eu2. pending queue on eu1 dropped from 18k -> 5.2k. eu2 request rate jumped ~2.3x. no immediate 5xx surge on eu2.

ellie (support): CS update: tell customers we enabled cross-region fallback; some will see slightly higher latency (~100-200ms) but service resumes. drafting message.

raj (runtime): observed one variant mismatch for a small subset (model v2.3 not available in eu2), fallback produced slightly different tokenization for short prompts. I'll put a temporary policy: for customers with strict model pinning, return 429 with helpful message instead of silently routing until we sync model variants.

kai (oncall): good call. raj, can you push a policy change to return 429 for pinned-model requests when fallback target doesn't have the variant?

raj (runtime): doing it now.

```yaml
# routing policy patch
match:
  - request.tenant.pinned_model
action:
  - if !target_has_variant -> return 429 "model-variant-unavailable; try later or contact support"
```

raj (runtime): patch applied. verified via canary traffic. 429s for pinned requests show correct body.

maria (sre): queue on eu1 continuing to drain but new pending oscillates between 3k-6k depending on burst. autoscaler still failing for primary region due to cloud quota; opened emergency quota request with provider (request id q-789001). ETA unknown.

kai (oncall): what's the customer-facing severity? SLOs impacted?

ellie (support): severity P1 for 2 enterprise customers (high impact), P2 for several mid-market ones. production jobs (batch) are timing out and some feature flags failing.

maria (sre): overall service error-rate increased 3.5x for that tenant cohort, global 500s up 0.8%. latency p50 increased ~150ms global, p95 increased ~1.4s.

ops-bot: update: playbook suggests also throttling best-effort routes to conserve eu2 capacity. recommend applying token-based throttle for embeddings-heavy endpoints.

kai (oncall): applying soft-throttle to embeddings route: reduce rate-limit per-token to 60% of normal for 15m.

sasha (eng): also enabling KV-cache warmup on eu2 for hottest prefixes to reduce tokens. launching warmup job now (10k prefixes).

```python
# warmup snippet
for p in hot_prefixes:
    client.prefetch(prefix=p, model="x-embed-v1", region="eu2")
```

sasha (eng): warmup job running; memory check passed.

maria (sre): 12m after mitigation: eu1 pending queue is down to ~900. eu2 latency stable. quotas still pending but fallback strategy holding. I recommend we keep emergency_fallback enabled for another 30m and then roll back once autoscaler quotas resolved or capacity added.

ellie (support): sending customer notification: "We experienced GPU capacity saturation in eu1. To maintain service, we temporarily routed traffic to eu2; you may notice slightly higher latency. Team is working on restoring eu1 capacity and will follow up."

kai (oncall): handover: I'll be on for another 30m, then handing to maria for steady-state monitoring. Maria, please note: check q-789001 and coordinate with cloud ops to lift quota or schedule capacity increase.

maria (sre): ack. I'll take post-incident monitoring and coordinate with cloud support. logging all actions to incident ticket INC-296789.

raj (runtime): postmortem notes to collect: autoscaler failure modes (quota_exceeded, launch_timeout), tenant pinning semantics leading to sticky routing, model variant coverage across regions, and runbook clarity for emergency_fallback.

sasha (eng): add suggestion: periodic model-variant syncs across regions and pre-warming reserved burst pools during marketing/expected bursts.

incident-bot: incident acknowledged and assigned INC-296789. Timeline and actions recorded.

kai (oncall): handing off to maria in 25m. closing live coordination channel unless escalation. great job everyone :thumbsup:

maria (sre): final note before takeover: schedule a brief post-call at +2h to confirm rollback plan and customer follow-ups.

ellie (support): will send follow-up messages and close priority tickets once eu1 restored.

ops-bot: summary: mitigations applied: unpinned tenants, emergency_fallback enabled, embeddings throttle, warmup job, model-variant 429 policy. Impact: temporary increased latency for routed customers, reduced 504s. Next steps: quota resolution, postmortem, runbook updates.
